test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7420529699916b6e5fc07cdfa3f34e8839b1a44bdaa7020ce27eab61ac73ac91.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The corner elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The center elements of 1st an 4th column are replaced by new element.

The rest of the elements interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93101f428c16c6d4fbeea125304cc14f879249f7a0f816878945f75e9440f6f1.png] 

2) Second box series →

The 1st and 2nd column elements shift clockwise subsequently.

The 3rd and 4th column elements shift anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c49c41a9bb07a6b2c4c423b3121e3d7a6ddd9a3795b50f3e27f92a8a7a08c69.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b23f9aa4a4ed706e6debceccc5d444fc633be62fd519dbf5a3262d6a9eea48f.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
